description: BanE-16 combines Bangladesh electricity-system demand and generation information with environmental variables for energy-forecasting research. Daffodil International University researchers identify Bangladesh Power Development Board information and temperature, wind and pressure measurements among the sources. Mendeley version 2 provides one CSV file free under CC BY 4.0. The repository describes numerical and time-series variables, but its short metadata do not establish exact observation dates, sampling interval, spatial aggregation or the number of observations. The article’s general statements about sensor collection do not resolve those details. These gaps limit immediate comparison with independently measured grid series. A reviewer-assessed use is exploring weather-demand relationships or constructing demand assumptions for electricity planning simulations, after checking the file documentation and units. model-pypsa is a related planning resource, without demonstrated direct compatibility. No CSV was downloaded, no forecasting model was run, and the accuracy of the combined measurements was not independently assessed.
